findings.current: All the more so when a full course of unspeakably horrific torture is waiting just beyond it.
findings.defect: Places the torture beyond death rather than before it.
findings.rationale: 그 죽음 앞에 places the torture ahead of death.
findings.replacement: All the more so when a full course of unspeakably horrific torture awaits you before death.
findings.source: 더군다나 그 죽음 앞에, 차마 입에 담을 수 없는 끔찍한 고문 풀코스가 예약되어 있다면 더더욱.

findings.current: Those you call lawless ruffians from the martial world fought a desperate battle and ended up covered in blood, while those of you who call yourselves ministers of the court somehow look untouched after such a fierce battle.
findings.defect: Turns the single bloodied martial artist the Emperor is defending into a group.
findings.rationale: The Emperor contrasts the singular 무뢰배, visibly bloodied, with the unscathed officials.
findings.replacement: The martial-world ruffian you speak of fought desperately and ended up covered in blood, while you ministers of the court somehow look untouched after such a fierce battle.
findings.source: 그대들이 말하는 강호의 무뢰배는 악전고투를 치르며 저리 피투성이가 되었는데, 조정의 중신들이라는 자들은 이 치열한 전투 속에서도 어찌 그리 멀쩡한 모습들인지.

findings.current: Even if the poison that cast its long shadow of death over the imperial family had been the Blood Soul Gu, the Slaughter Saint and the Divine Physician I knew would have found some way to deal with it.
findings.rationale: 찾을 수도 있었을 테니까 preserves Taekyung’s uncertainty.
findings.replacement: Even if the poison that cast its long shadow of death over the imperial family had been the Blood Soul Gu, the Slaughter Saint and the Divine Physician I knew might have found some way to deal with it.
findings.source: 설령 황실에 짙은 죽음의 그림자를 드리운 독의 정체가 혈혼고(血魂蠱)라 해도, 내가 아는 살성과 신의라면 어떻게든 방법을 찾을 수도 있었을 테니까.

findings.current: But the cruel twist of fate ended with the deaths of the late Emperor, the Crown Prince, and several other members of the imperial family.
findings.defect: Changes the plural crown princes into one Crown Prince.
findings.replacement: But the cruel twist of fate ended with the deaths of the late Emperor, the crown princes, and several other members of the imperial family.
findings.source: 하지만 그 공교로운 운명의 끝은 선황과 황태자들을 비롯한 여러 황족들의 죽음이었고

findings.current: He’d fought against the imperial palace and Baek Yeon, and suffered injuries so severe he could never recover.
findings.defect: Mistakes the Bow Saint’s title for the imperial palace.
findings.rationale: 궁성 is the established title Bow Saint; the passage names two opponents.
findings.replacement: He’d fought against the Bow Saint and Baek Yeon, and suffered injuries so severe he could never recover.
findings.source: 그는 궁성과 백연에 맞서 싸우다가 회복할 수 없는 극심한 부상을 입었고

findings.current: Me, the Emperor, Baek Yeon, and the Fire King.
findings.defect: Substitutes Baek Yeon for the Bow Saint among those left speechless.
findings.rationale: 궁성 refers to the Bow Saint, not Baek Yeon.
findings.replacement: Me, the Emperor, the Bow Saint, and the Fire King.

findings.current: Toward the enemy who had killed his parents and elder brother.
findings.defect: Changes his brothers into one elder brother.
findings.rationale: 형제 is plural here and does not specify an elder brother.
findings.replacement: Toward the enemy who had killed his parents and brothers.
findings.source: 다름 아닌 자신의 부모와 형제를 죽인 원수를 향해.

findings.defect: Intensifies the Demon Lord’s restrained curse.
findings.rationale: 빌어먹을 conveys a curse, but not the stronger profanity of “fucking”; his phrasing remains measured.

summary: The draft changes two identities, several quantities and relationships, and the timing of the torture. It also makes one medical possibility certain and intensifies the closing profanity.
